answer: The response depends on canal shape, so 396 fakes need 396 distinct ears, not 396 copies of one recording. The probe tone is randomized per epoch and the response re-matched. The meadow is the wall and the beacon is the gate: A sound is played into the ear canal and the reflected response forms an acoustic profile. A farm of 396 aliases must climb the wall 396 times, the pearl ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
